verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਆਸ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhoojee aas vinaas hai pooree kiau hovai|

en.bdb: Other hopes (except Lord's) are ruination; how could they be accomplished.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਮੋਹ ਸੁ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਸਭੁ ਓਹੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਗੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhoojaa moh su dhroh sabh oh a(n)t vigovai|

en.bdb: Other infatuations are delusion which ultimately lead (man) astray.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਸੁਭਰਮ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਰੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhoojaa karam subharam hai kar avagun rovai|

en.bdb: Other actions are deceits by which man cultivates demerits and suffers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਕੁਢੰਗੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਭਰਿਆ ਧੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhoojaa sa(n)g kudda(n)g hai kiau bhariaa dhovai|

en.bdb: The company of the sense of otherness is a perfidious way of living; and how it could wash away the sinful life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਕੁਦਾਉ ਹੈ ਹਾਰਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਖਲੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhoojaa bhaau kudhaau hai haar janam khalovai|

en.bdb: The othemness is a wrong stake which ultimatley makes one lose the (battle of) life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾਂ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਣੀ ਪਰੋਵੈ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit_en: peer mureedhaa(n) pirahaRee gun gunee parovai ||12||

en.bdb: The love between the Sikhs and the Guru, brings the meritorious people closer and makes them one (sangat).
